title: Allu Arjun and Lokesh Kanagaraj Just Shot Something in Mumbai — and Indian Cinema Might Never Be the Same
excerpt: The Pushpa megastar meets the architect of the Lokesh Cinematic Universe for AA23, a pan-Indian action film with Anirudh on the score and a silver kada that has the internet losing sleep
body:
Two of the biggest names in Indian cinema walked into a Mumbai set this week, and you could practically hear the internet hold its breath. **Allu Arjun** — the man who made Pushpa a global phenomenon — and **Lokesh Kanagaraj** — the director who built an entire cinematic universe out of Vikram, Kaithi, and Leo — have begun work on **AA23**, and the first shots have already been fired.

According to reports from Aakashavaani, the team conducted a trial shoot in Mumbai on June 26, and this wasn't just a photoshoot for a first-look poster. This was actual production footage. The kind that tells you the film isn't just an announcement anymore — it's alive, it's in motion, and it's coming for everything.

## The Silver Kada That Changed Everything

When AA23 was first announced, the teaser gave away almost nothing — except for one detail that sent fans into overdrive. **Allu Arjun was wearing the silver kada**, the metallic wrist accessory that has become the signature visual motif of Lokesh Kanagaraj's interconnected films. In the LCU, the kada isn't just jewellery. It's a badge. It means your character exists in the same universe as **Kamal Haasan's Vikram**, **Vijay's Leo**, and **Rajinikanth's Coolie**.

The implication is staggering. After Pushpa turned Allu Arjun into arguably the biggest draw in Indian cinema, placing him inside the LCU makes this the single most commercially explosive crossover in the industry's history. It's the Avengers play, except everyone involved has already had solo blockbusters that crossed ₹500 crore.

## Anirudh on the Score — Because of Course

**Anirudh Ravichander** — the man who composed the themes for Vikram, Leo, Jailer, and Coolie — is handling the music and background score for AA23. This marks his first-ever collaboration with Allu Arjun, and frankly, the pairing is almost unfairly exciting. Anirudh's ability to build tension, drop beats that go viral before the film even releases, and create themes that define characters is unmatched in Indian cinema right now.

The "23 Theme" has already gained significant traction on Instagram Reels, and the film hasn't even properly started shooting yet. That's the kind of anticipation we're dealing with.

> "This will be a proper pan-Indian film, given its broad international appeal." — **Rathna Kumar**, co-writer and director who works with Lokesh Kanagaraj

## Pooja Hegde in the Frame

While not officially confirmed, reports indicate that **Pooja Hegde** may play the female lead. If true, it reunites her with Allu Arjun after the massive success of **Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo** — a film that single-handedly proved Telugu cinema could dominate Hindi-language streaming charts. Their chemistry in that 2020 blockbuster was electric, and bringing it back for a Lokesh Kanagaraj action universe film is a smart play.

## Allu Arjun's Loaded Calendar

AA23 sits in what might be the most stacked lineup any Indian actor has ever committed to. Before this, Allu Arjun will complete **Raaka** with director **Atlee** (the man behind Jawan), which is described as one of his most technically ambitious projects — featuring extensive CGI, reportedly four distinct characters, and a parallel-universe narrative. **Deepika Padukone** is confirmed as the female lead on Raaka, with **Rashmika Mandanna** also expected in a key role.

After AA23, he's rumoured to team up with **Basil Joseph**, the director of the cult Malayalam superhero hit Minnal Murali.

That's three of the most exciting directors in Indian cinema, back to back to back. Allu Arjun isn't just booking films — he's booking an era.

## What This Means for the Diaspora

Here's the part that matters for anyone watching from New York, London, or Toronto. The LCU has already proven it can dominate international markets — Vikram and Leo both had massive diaspora runs. Allu Arjun's Pushpa 2 set worldwide records that Hindi films struggled to match. Combining the two means AA23 will almost certainly get the widest opening-day release an Indian film has ever received in overseas markets.

The trial shoot is done. The wheels are turning. The kada is on. And if you know anything about what happens when Lokesh Kanagaraj starts a project, you know the internet is about to become insufferable with fan theories. We are, frankly, here for every single one of them.
